title: Bad payment model
body:
Subscription model or one time fee- but you get ads and only one entry on the free version? Yikes. If there are going to be ads, open up the full version for free.  
As for the app, I had to sit through a 30 second ad when I went to add a habit that didn’t even save. 
Too bad; could have been what I was looking for but the paywall with ads really put me off.

title: Perfect!
body:
I love this app. This is exactly what I was looking for in a routine/habit tracking app. It is perfectly simple and just works. I like the UI as well as the features. I extra like it has a built it pomo timer! 
Also, the developer has been super helpful and responsive. That seems to be a rarity. I highly recommend this app to anyone looking for a routine/habit tracker

title: Great!

title: It’s best app!
